arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: General Olson argued California transferred regulatory power to private parties.
Hoeber argued Kasky lacked standing because he never bought shoes.
Tribe noted Nike's global production in fifty-one countries.
Rehnquist closed the argument and submitted the case.
